identity.title: Fallingwater
identity.summary: Commissioned by Edgar J. Kaufmann, the main house was constructed from 1936–1938; a guest house followed in 1939.
identity.projectBrief: Designed by Frank Lloyd Wright for Edgar J. Kaufmann as a weekend residence at Bear Run, Fallingwater places the house directly above the waterfall. Site-quarried sandstone anchors the composition while reinforced-concrete terraces project outward over the stream, joining landscape, structure, material and occupation into one architectural system.

claims.label: Project Type
claims.value: Weekend house / residence

claims.label: Location
claims.value: Mill Run, Pennsylvania, USA

claims.label: Lead Designer
claims.value: Frank Lloyd Wright

claims.label: Completion
claims.value: Main house completed in 1937; guest house completed in 1939

claims.label: Status
claims.value: Preserved under Western Pennsylvania Conservancy stewardship

claims.label: Use
claims.value: Originally commissioned as a weekend house for the Kaufmann family

claims.label: Commission
claims.value: Edgar J. Kaufmann commissioned Frank Lloyd Wright to design a weekend house near Bear Run

claims.label: Purpose
claims.value: Create a weekend residence for the Kaufmann family at Bear Run

claims.label: Lead Team
claims.value: Frank Lloyd Wright served as architect for client Edgar J. Kaufmann and the Kaufmann family

claims.label: Programme
claims.value: Main house, extensive outdoor terraces and a later guest house

claims.label: Scale
claims.value: Main house approximately 9,300 sq ft and guest house approximately 4,990 sq ft, including substantial terrace areas

claims.label: Development
claims.value: Designed in 1935, construction began in 1936, the main house was completed in 1937 and the guest house in 1939

claims.label: Stewardship
claims.value: Edgar Kaufmann jr. entrusted Fallingwater to the Western Pennsylvania Conservancy in 1963

claims.label: Current Status
claims.value: The property remains under Western Pennsylvania Conservancy stewardship

claims.label: Recognition
claims.value: Fallingwater was inscribed in 2019 as a component of The 20th-Century Architecture of Frank Lloyd Wright

claims.label: Context
claims.value: The house occupies the Bear Run site near Mill Run and is positioned directly above the waterfall

claims.label: Bear Run
claims.value: The waterfall at Bear Run is the project's primary site condition

claims.label: Position Above the Waterfall
claims.value: The house is positioned above the waterfall rather than facing it from a detached viewpoint

claims.label: Landscape Setting
claims.value: The wooded Bear Run landscape is treated as an integral part of the architectural composition

claims.label: Primary Design Order
claims.value: A central sandstone mass anchors the composition while rooms and terraces extend outward

claims.label: Cantilevered Terraces
claims.value: Stacked terraces project outward above Bear Run and extend occupation into the landscape

claims.label: Interior–Exterior Relationship
claims.value: Interior rooms and exterior terraces form a layered spatial relationship with the surrounding landscape

claims.label: Outdoor Terraces
claims.value: Outdoor terraces form a substantial proportion of both the main-house and guest-house floor areas

claims.label: Primary Structural System
claims.value: Reinforced concrete enables the principal projecting cantilevers and terraces

claims.label: Masonry Anchor
claims.value: Locally quarried Pottsville sandstone forms the central chimney and major masonry elements

claims.label: Structural Projection
claims.value: The cantilevered concrete trays carry terraces outward above the stream

claims.label: Cantilever Strengthening
claims.value: Structural strengthening of the principal living-room cantilevers was completed in 2002

claims.label: Sandstone
claims.value: Site-quarried Pottsville sandstone provides the principal masonry material

claims.label: Reinforced Concrete
claims.value: Reinforced concrete forms the projecting terraces and major horizontal elements

claims.label: Steel
claims.value: Painted steel forms part of Fallingwater's documented material and structural construction

claims.label: Wastewater System
claims.value: A closed-loop, zero-discharge wastewater treatment facility was installed in 2003; treated water is reused for non-potable uses and drip irrigation

claims.label: Long-Term Structural Responsibility
claims.value: The later cantilever strengthening documents the long-term structural consequences of the original projecting system
